## Physical Modeling in MATLAB

We use an adaptation of *Physical Modeling in MATLAB* by Allen Downey ([Green Tea Press](https://greenteapress.com/wp/physical-modeling-in-matlab/)), revised for AE2440 by Brian Bingham. The whole book is available as a PDF:

- [PhysicalModelingInMatlabAE2440.pdf](files/PhysicalModelingInMatlabAE2440.pdf) (release 25-3)

## Chapters by week

Each week's reading is also released chapter by chapter from the [Schedule](../schedule.qmd), so you can read just what is assigned. The chapters are the same text as the whole-book PDF.

| Week | Chapter | Formats |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1. Modeling and Simulation | [PDF](../weeks/w01_modeling_scripts/files/modeling.pdf) |
| 1 | 2. Scripts | [PDF](../weeks/w01_modeling_scripts/files/scripts.pdf) |
| 2 | 3. Loops | [PDF](../weeks/w02_loops_vectors/files/loops.pdf) |
| 2 | 4. Vectors | [PDF](../weeks/w02_loops_vectors/files/vectors.pdf) |

Later weeks are added as they are posted.

## Code

The source code for the book (`.m` and `.mlx` files) is on GitHub: [bsb808/PhysicalModelingInMatlab, branch `ae2440-dev`, `code/`](https://github.com/bsb808/PhysicalModelingInMatlab/tree/ae2440-dev/code).

- To download one file, open it on GitHub and use the "Download raw file" button (the down-arrow icon at the top right of the file view).
- To download all the code, go to the [repository main page](https://github.com/bsb808/PhysicalModelingInMatlab/tree/ae2440-dev), select the green "Code" button, then "Download ZIP".
